thread:
Sam: quick follow-up from the postmortem — putting all remediation owners and timelines in one thread so we can track.

Sam: tl;dr: recurring pattern was slow detection of rollout regressions + no fast auto-rollback for emergent kg/regression signals. we need short-term mitigations and medium-term infra changes.

Alyssa: thanks. I can take ownership of the short-term auto-rollback prototype. plan: detect error-rate or latency spike > 4% over baseline for 90s -> trigger a rollback to previous model variant. will prototype in staging this week.

Michael: +1. we should scope the feature-flag blast radius controls at route level, not global. example: `/v1/generate` canary only 5% traffic, not whole API key.

Jordan: also propose a sampling hedging layer: if canary shows anomaly, divert additional 10% to a safe fallback model instead of immediate rollback so downstream user impact is minimized.

Carol: runbook update owner: Carol. ETA for runbook edits + playbook snippets: 2026-04-02. i'll add exact rollback steps, escalation matrix, and observability checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-29T14:02:12Z started canary rollout for model-rl-2026-03
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-29T14:04:05Z canary healthcheck failed: error-rate 6.2% (threshold 4%). auto-rollback not enabled — manual rollback initiated by @Michael

Michael: rolled back at 14:04. confirms the gap — we need a default safe auto-rollback policy for emergent regressions.

Alyssa: short-term checklist (prototype):
- implement auto-rollback rule engine (owner: Alyssa)
- expose per-route canary scope + max blast radius config (owner: Michael)
- add diversion-to-fallback policy (owner: Jordan)
- runbook + playbooks updated (owner: Carol)

Sam: assign owners and rough timelines here (add comments inline if you need different dates):
- Alyssa: auto-rollback prototype in staging by 2026-03-31, canary test 2026-04-01
- Michael: per-route blast radius config POC by 2026-04-07
- Jordan: fallback diversion logic POC by 2026-04-05
- Carol: runbook + playbook updates by 2026-04-02

Alyssa: confirming those dates. i'll include a simple rule DSL: `when metric('error_rate') > 0.04 for 90s then rollback_to('prev_variant') else notify('oncall')` — will add exponential backoff + cooldown.

Michael: we should also add a safelist for long-running jobs and admin keys so rollback doesn't break migrations. add `exclude_keys: ['admin', 'migration']` to config.

Jordan: for medium-term: instrument per-session KV-caching fallback so model degradation doesn't cascade to user-visible latency. this removes some pressure for immediate rollbacks.

Sam: noted recurring incident patterns: detection lag (alerts tuned too slow), wide canary scope, no fallback path, runbook outdated. tie each short-term action to metrics we can validate (error-rate, median latency, pct99 tail).

Carol: i will coordinate a tabletop drill for next Tue to exercise auto-rollback and fallback flows. proposed drill: 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC. who can join?

Michael: i'll join.

Alyssa: i can run the auto-rollback scenario and bring the staging harness.

Jordan: count me in for verifying diversion flow and metrics.

Sam: great. next steps: owners update tickets in the postmortem board with ETA + validation plan. i'll check back Friday for status. if anyone wants to change ownership/timeline, reply here and update the ticket.

Michael: added ticket INF-8243 for per-route blast radius config.
Alyssa: added ticket INF-8244 for auto-rollback rule engine.
Jordan: added ticket INF-8245 for fallback diversion.
Carol: added ticket INF-8246 for runbook updates + drill coordination.

Sam: thanks all. after the drill we'll decide which policies become default (sensible starting defaults: canary 5%, auto-rollback on error-rate >4% for 90s, diversion to fallback 10%).

Alyssa: logging note — auto-rollback actions must emit `event.type = "rollout.rollback"` with `reason` + `metric_snapshot` for audits.

Michael: also add metric `canary_latency_drift` so we can detect quality regressions that aren't error-rate based.

Sam: ok closing this thread for now — update tickets and ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
